description: This file declares a C++ interface for database operations within the beerocks::bpl namespace, including functions for adding, setting, retrieving, and removing entries, as well as committing changes. It primarily defines function prototypes without actual implementation.

methods.name: db_has_entry
methods.description: Checks if an entry of specified type and name exists in the database.

methods.name: db_add_entry
methods.description: Adds a new entry with specified parameters to the database, optionally committing immediately.

methods.name: db_set_entry
methods.description: Sets or updates the attributes of an existing entry, optionally committing immediately.

methods.name: db_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves all values of a specific entry given its type and name.

methods.name: db_get_entries_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves all entries of a specific type, returning a nested map of entries and their attributes.

methods.name: db_remove_entry
methods.description: Removes an entry by name and type, optionally committing immediately.

methods.name: db_commit_changes
methods.description: Commits all pending changes to the database.
